entry.title: BOXING TABATA WORKOUT (30 min) - for all levels!

media:group.media:title: BOXING TABATA WORKOUT (30 min) - for all levels!
media:group.media:description:
Welcome to JENNY FIT START! The workout videos on this channel are for all ages, levels, and sizes, but designed for the active senior and beginner. This video is made by Jenny McClendon, MS, CGCP - licensed Physical Therapist with over 33 years experience.
This video will take you through a great 30 minute interval workout, called BOXING TABATA. 6 Tabata cycles, each cycle includes 8 exercises - each exercise is 20 seconds long, with a 10 second break in between, and a 1 minute rest between each cycle. Low impact cardio and strength workout. No equipment needed (unless you want to hold light weights or weighted gloves). Easy to follow! This can help improve your cardiovascular endurance, power, agility, balance, rhythm, coordination, bone density, overall strength and more...and PLUS it's FUN! This, in turn, can increase ease with everyday daily activities. ENJOY!
* To order weighted gloves, click this link: https://www.jennyfitstart.com/weighted-gloves * To order a weighted vest, click this link: https://www.jennyfitstart.com/weighted-vest
